narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed during the late afternoon and evening hours ahead of a cold front approaching the Ohio Valley Region.
ev: Numerous roads were closed due to water flowing across them. These included State Route 121, Columbia Road, Flat Ridge Bridge, Ott Road and Laurel Road.
High water was flowing over Old Michigan Road.
Several inches of water were flowing across U.S. Route 421 in Napoleon.
